items.topic: Duplicate detection error root cause
items.statement: Records where deal and operator match but country/state differ are detected as duplicates because deal country and state do not come in; that path has poor error handling. Errors roll back the whole transaction, so records are not saved. Kobi suspects US deals with multiple states are the ones failing.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: operator um that are the same but the country and state would be different. So those are getting detected as duplicates in the system right now because we don't have the deal country and deal state coming in. / Kobi Kunasekaran: I have a feeling it's because of the the block because I think the it looks like most of these are Canadian. So the US ones had the multiple states and that's likely what's erroring out.
